units.source_text: 阿泷头也不回地说了一声“阿雪会游泳吗”，就攥住小姑娘的手腕，走过河滩上的桥。

en.t: Without even turning her head, Otaki called out, "Can Oyuki swim?" Then she seized the young girl's wrist and crossed the bridge over the riverbed.

units.source_text: 阿雪裸露着身体，羞羞答答地瑟缩着腹部。

en.t: Oyuki stood naked, bashfully drawing in her stomach.

units.source_text: 阿泷看见阿雪这副模样，就猛然敲了一下她的头。

en.t: When Otaki saw Oyuki like that, she suddenly rapped her on the head.
